meta.name: surge-landing
meta.description:
Use when asked to design growth-optimized landing pages, activation funnel
layouts, or experiment-friendly page structures. Examples: "growth-optimized
landing", "activation funnel layout", "A/B testable page"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计增长优化的着陆页，提升转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要搭建高转化的营销着陆页
copy.tagline_en: Design conversion-optimized landing pages and activation funnels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to create high-converting landing pages

howto.what: 装好后，Claude会按照40行CLI格式生成增长优化着陆页布局表，包含各部分用途、是否可实验、激活触发器、漏斗结构、摩擦点和实验面。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计增长导向的着陆页、激活漏斗布局或A/B测试页面时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个SaaS产品的激活漏斗着陆页。
say.note: Claude会搜索增长模式并输出布局表。

say.text: 我想要一个可A/B测试的注册页结构。
say.note: Claude会识别实验面并输出表格。

say.text: 为免费试用产品设计增长页面。
say.note: Claude会搜索产品推理和摩擦点。

howto.what_en: When loaded, Claude outputs a growth-optimized landing page layout table in 40-line CLI format, including section purpose, experiment surfaces, activation triggers, funnel structure, friction points.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests growth-optimized landing pages, activation funnel layouts, or A/B testable page structures.

say_en.text: Design an activation funnel landing page for a SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude searches growth patterns and outputs a layout table.

say_en.text: Create an A/B testable sign-up page structure.
say_en.note: Claude identifies experiment surfaces and outputs a table.

say_en.text: Design a growth page for a free trial product.
say_en.note: Claude searches product reasoning and friction points.
